collection.title: Jaguar XJ XJ8 1995 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Jaguar XJ8 1995 to 2003 model requires a 21" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
